items.title: 폭락한 구찌, 믿었던 에르메스·루이비통마저…명품주 '패닉', 왜
items.summary: Kering shares plunged 16.57 percent in a single session, the worst drop in company history and roughly a 50 percent decline over one year, after Gucci Q3 sales fell 6 percent. Hermes and LVMH also sold off; the piece attributes the panic to Middle East conflict, oil prices, Chinese tax enforcement on wealthy individuals, weakening US consumer spending and European unrest.

items.title: 잘 나가던 명품 '주춤'…가격 인상 피로감에 소비 열기 식나
items.summary: Department-store luxury sales growth fell from 40 percent (Q2) to just 10 percent by October, with the piece naming accumulated price-hike fatigue and a shrinking wealth effect as causes. Gucci's 6 percent Q3 sales decline and Kering's roughly 40 percent stock drop this year are cited as the sharpest case; Boucheron reversing a July price hike by October is flagged as a symptom of the broader pricing-power unwind.

items.title: ケリング株が一時16%超の急落、第3四半期の「グッチ」の売上低迷と再建への不透明感
items.summary: Kering shares plunged more than 16 percent intraday after Gucci's Q3 comparable sales fell 6 percent, deepening doubts about the brand's turnaround under Demna; piece frames continued China weakness as the central drag on recovery visibility.

items.source: SMZDM (什么值得买, Chinese consumer/shopping community)
items.title: 一只古驰包降了3600元，奥莱门口还在排队：现在买，先分清「降价」和「保值」
items.summary: Consumer-community explainer breaking down Gucci's China price cuts (Mercato tote 25,500 to 20,000 yuan; Ophidia mini bucket 12,300 to 8,700 yuan) alongside plans to close at least 125 stores globally in 2026. Notes severe resale depreciation (a 21,000 yuan bag fetching only 2,800-4,500 yuan secondhand) and advises consumers to abandon value-retention expectations and buy only for personal use.

items.title: 古驰国内和国外价差有多少？实测最高省10900元
items.summary: Weibo luxury-goods account post quantifying Gucci's China-vs-Europe price gap post tax refund (30-60 percent cheaper in Europe depending on style; up to 10,900 yuan savings on popular bags), advising Chinese shoppers on when to buy abroad versus domestically.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀+关店105家+中国制造
items.summary: Weibo explainer-style post summarizing three major recent Gucci developments: Demna's runway debut, net closure of 105 stores in the first three quarters of 2026, and the brand's first China-manufactured sneaker line, framed as a mix of reinvention and retrenchment.

items.title: 激烈的对立——GUCCI2026秋冬秀场解读
items.summary: Zhihu long-form essay interpreting Demna's Gucci F/W26 show as a deliberate staging of tension and contrast (bodies, heritage versus provocation); an independent critical reading rather than brand-supplied copy, mixed-to-analytical in tone rather than simple praise.

items.title: 为了救Gucci，巴黎世家的后门都被抄了
items.summary: Zhihu essay arguing Demna is importing Balenciaga-honed tactics wholesale to try to rescue Gucci, framed skeptically as derivative rather than a genuine new direction for the house.

items.title: 4대 명품그룹, 중국서 모두 고전
items.summary: Korean trade-press roundup reporting that all four major luxury groups, including Kering/Gucci, are struggling in China amid weakening consumer sentiment, with comparisons across LVMH, Kering, Richemont and others.

items.title: "가격 올려도 줄 서서 사더니"…소비자들 달라졌다
items.summary: Report on shifting Korean consumer behavior toward luxury brands, including Gucci, noting that the once-reliable pattern of consumers queuing despite repeated price increases is breaking down as department-store luxury sales growth decelerates sharply through October.

items.title: 今週のファッショントレンドまとめ（2026年10月26日～11月1日）
items.summary: Japanese fashion-trend weekly roundup covering the week of Oct 26-Nov 1, 2026, including Gucci among other brand activity; largely descriptive trend-digest coverage rather than evaluative.

items.title: 【GUCCI】「GucciCore」のローンチを記念し、東京でのポップアップショップと日本限定モデル〔グッチ NY トートバッグ〕が登場
items.summary: Brand-issued press release announcing a Tokyo pop-up store (Isetan Shinjuku, Nov 4-10) and a Japan-exclusive GucciCore tote model to mark the GucciCore campaign launch; purely descriptive promotional announcement with no independent evaluative content.

items.title: 구찌, 뉴욕을 배경으로 다채로운 개성을 담은 '구찌코어(GucciCore)' 캠페인 공개
items.summary: Descriptive coverage of the GucciCore campaign shot in New York, listing wardrobe items such as peacoats, trench coats and suits; purely promotional write-up with no critical framing.

items.title: 肖战的逆风翻盘：半年三奢代言在手！'品牌代言人'为何难得？
items.summary: Chinese entertainment/business media piece on ambassador Xiao Zhan's run of three luxury-brand deals including Gucci, discussing why brand-ambassador status is hard to sustain; largely descriptive celebrity-business coverage rather than product evaluation.

items.title: Gucci to Show Next Collection in Los Angeles
items.summary: BoF confirms Gucci's next runway show will take place in Los Angeles on November 3, ahead of the LACMA Art+Film Gala, as the brand continues alternating major shows between global cities under Demna.
items.note: Primarily a global brand-scheduling announcement; pooled here because NEA media/fan attention to ambassador attendance at the LA show is a recurring angle.
